text:
maria: Quick heads-up — I'm rolling a dry-run for three runtime flags to canary group B (staging + infra team). Flags: flash_attn_v2, spec_dec_override, kv_cache_prefetch. Running smoke tests now.
infra-bot: Started canary run id=cr-2087654321, cohort=canary-B.
jon: ETA for smoke results?
maria: ~5–10m.
tara: Reminder: kill-switch is `runtime.kill_all_optimizations` in FF dashboard. Use `--force` only if latency spikes.
lee: small ask — can we keep spec_dec window at 32 for the canary? PR toggles change it to 48.
sam: PR #4123 adjusts spec_dec threshold, pinged for review.
maria: I want to validate quality regressions with prompt set "email-summaries". Will run evals after smoke.
jon: If we see >1% token-level perplexity delta revert.
tara: also watch KV hit-rate metric; prefetch tradeoffs showed +3% cpu in last run.
infra-bot: smoke tests: 200/200 requests successful, p50 38ms, p95 142ms.
maria: nice.
lee: @sam can you review #4123 and approve if ok?
sam: on it, will skim in 10.
jon: one more — if p95 >200ms auto-kill to fallback model variant. Add to rollout policy?
maria: added auto-fallback rule in config, see snippet: ```yaml
rollout_policy:
  - trigger: p95>200ms
    action: revert_to:
      model: redwood-base-v1
```
tara: we should document the guardrail in the runbook.
maria: added a line in runbook draft and flagged ops-docs.
sam: LGTM on code, left one nit.
lee: nit addressed, merging now.
infra-bot: rollout state: canary-B -> 50% traffic routed, watchers: eng-runtime.
jon: thanks — team standup update: will keep canary for 2 hours and then expand if metrics stable.
maria: thx, posting results to #eng-sre later. :thumbsup:
